description: Search the company's Nomid Library: its apps (private Android apps uploaded to Nomid, with package name, version and categories) or, with kind "links", its web links (VR library). Returns how many the Library has, how many match and the matches, each app with its portal link. Only the Library: an app from Google Play or one a policy installs is not here (read the policy with get_policy_settings), nor what a device has installed (list_device_apps), so "not in the Library" never means "not on the devices".

category.description: Optional, apps only. Apps with a category containing this text.

company.description: Optional: a `company` value from list_companies to run this in. Omit it for the connection's own company.

kind.description: What to search: apps (default) or links (web links of the VR library).

limit.description: At most this many results, 1-50. Default 20. The counts always cover every match.

query.description: Optional. Apps whose name or package name, or links whose title or URL, contain this text (case-insensitive). Leave it out to list everything.

name: search_library
title: Search the Library
